errors.text: The fracture morphology is reversed: the target reports distributed/isolated microcracks after HPHT versus elongated interfacial cracks in the baseline, whereas the generated hypothesis assigns elongated cracks to the treated sample and isolated microcracks to the baseline.
The central mechanical outcome—approximately 1150 MPa strength and 36% tensile elongation, representing nearly simultaneous doubling of strength and ductility—is omitted from the prediction.

The cited evidence concerns materially different alloy systems and processing problems and does not substantiate the specific 6 GPa, 1473 K hierarchical transformation or coherent-interface mechanism.
